subject: Fastest air freight quote: DUS to MEX
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the fastest air freight option from DUS to MEX? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-29, and we’ll deliver it to DUS ourselves.

It’s 4 pieces of electronic control units, 1124 kg gross and 6.80 cbm. Please include the transit time and an all-in price in EUR.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
